title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 5: Naaman the Syrian is healed in the Jordan, and Gehazi's greed brings Naaman's leprosy on himself.

questions.text: Naaman was captain of the army of which king?
questions.explanation: Naaman was captain of the army of the king of Syria, a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

questions.text: Who told Naaman's wife about the prophet in Samaria?
questions.explanation: A little maiden brought captive from Israel, who waited on Naaman's wife, wished that her lord were with the prophet in Samaria.

answers.text: A priest of the house of Rimmon
A little maiden taken captive from Israel

questions.text: What did the king of Israel do when he read the letter from the king of Syria?
questions.explanation: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and asked, 'Am I God, to kill and to make alive?'

questions.text: What did Elisha's messenger tell Naaman to do?
questions.explanation: Elisha sent a messenger saying, 'Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.'

answers.text: Offer a sacrifice on the altar
Go back to Damascus and wait
Wash in the Jordan seven times
Fast and pray for three days

questions.text: Which rivers of Damascus did Naaman think were better than all the waters of Israel?
questions.explanation: Naaman asked, 'Aren't Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel?'

questions.text: What was Naaman's flesh like after he dipped himself in the Jordan?
questions.explanation: His flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

answers.text: Like the flesh of a little child
Rough like the bark of a tree
Like the flesh of an old man

questions.text: How did Elisha respond when Naaman offered him a gift?
questions.explanation: Elisha said, 'As Yahweh lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none,' and though Naaman urged him, he refused.

answers.text: He took half and gave it to the poor
He accepted it for the sons of the prophets
He told him to give it to the king

questions.text: What did Naaman ask to take home with him?
questions.explanation: Naaman asked that two mules' burden of earth be given to him, for he would offer sacrifice to no other god but Yahweh.

answers.text: A jar of water from the Jordan

questions.text: What did Gehazi ask Naaman for, claiming his master had sent him?
questions.explanation: Gehazi said that his master asked for a talent of silver and two changes of clothing for two young men of the sons of the prophets.

answers.text: Ten pieces of gold and a fine robe
A talent of silver and two changes of clothing
A chariot with two horses for the road
A bag of gold and a team of mules

questions.text: What happened to Gehazi as he went out from Elisha's presence?
questions.explanation: Elisha said the leprosy of Naaman would cling to him, and he went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.

answers.text: He was driven from the city
He was a leper, as white as snow
